items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses multiple critical vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-103849 (RCE) and CVE-2026-92909 (privilege escalation for B2B), allowing attackers to execute malicious code or gain elevated privileges. Adobe reported no active exploitation at the time of publication.

items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE
items.summary: This vulnerability, fixed in APSB26-153, is a CVSS 10.0 flaw allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution on Magento and Adobe Commerce servers. It is a template engine injection that builds upon the StyleSmuggler vulnerability.

items.title: Urgent Action Required Critical Security Update Available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves CVE-2026-75650, a critical zero-day vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on an affected installation. Adobe became aware of active exploitation of this flaw.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Discovered by Sansec, this zero-day vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution on Magento and Adobe Commerce, with attacks starting on September 4, 2026. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) on September 21, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362). Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Active Exploitation Alert: Adobe Commerce / Magento Incorrect Authorization Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical Incorrect Authorization flaw (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce allows unauthenticated customer account takeover, providing access to victim accounts and private data. It was fixed in APSB26-92 and added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on September 24, 2026.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system read, and application denial-of-service.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, arbitrary file system read, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.
